name: edge-magazine
description: A server-rendered magazine on Cloudflare Workers (Hono, D1, KV, R2) with an optional, guarded LLM drafting pipeline.

scripts.predeploy: npm run typecheck && npm run check:content && npm test
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.setup:local: npm run db:migrate:local && npm run seed:local && npm run gen:assets && npm run seed:images

DB.description: D1 database holding posts, authors, categories and the FTS5 search index.

CACHE_KV.description: KV namespace for rendered-page cache, runtime config (cfg:v1) and circuit-breaker state.

UPLOADS.description: R2 bucket for cover images and uploads.

AI.description: Workers AI, the default (keyless) provider for the optional drafting assistant.

GENERATE_QUEUE.description: Queue used by the admin "run now" button for background drafting.
